title: Knowledge_Basis (NFRA_EPISTEMY, PRD sec.2.3, PROPOSED 0.1.1 -- CTO gate 64047 condition applied)
description: The pinned five-member basis every assessment and lease evaluation cites (PRD sec.2.3, cited not copied). A basis is IMMUTABLE once minted; a change mints a NEW basis and a Basis_Change record. A signature edit or normalization change invalidates eligibility as surely as a new member -- invalidation is an ELIGIBILITY event, never a history edit. S6 0.1.2's knowledge_basis field carries these five members inline with the UNRATIFIED_BASIS null semantic; this object is the standalone form C4-LEASE evaluates against. Authored at CRO base (registry executor, S2); CTO arch gate precedes any consumer; exercised leg = C4-LEASE's first evaluation. Rule-24 record: KNOWLEDGE_BASIS_RULE24_RECORD.md (same dir).

members.description: Five fixed slots (PRD sec.2.3). Each is {ref, version} or null. ABSENCE SEMANTIC (S6 model): null = NO RATIFIED ARTIFACT EXISTS for that member at mint vintage (UNRATIFIED_BASIS) -- a declared state, never an omission; a consumer MUST NOT invent a version. Any null member is an open invalidation predicate by construction, and an Eligibility_Evaluation over an assessment citing a basis with null members returns at most UNKNOWN on the axes that member governs.

digest.description: sha256 over the CANONICAL serialization of members. NORMATIVE DERIVATION (0.1.1, CTO 64047 -- the 0.1.0 prose ASSERTED cross-seat determinism it did not have; CTO falsified it by exercise on two silent serializer axes): the derivation HOME is precondition_token.py _request_hash (:164-166, exercised) -- json.dumps(members, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True) with null members as the literal null, .encode("utf-8"), sha256, prefixed sha256: -- all four axes PINNED (sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=True stated, UTF-8); any other serialization is NON-CONFORMANT even if the digest pattern matches. This is the knowledge_basis_digest the Mutation_Capability (S5) and S6 instances carry.

minted_by.description: seat serial; minting is a base registrar act after CTO gate on any member's ratification

predecessor_basis_id.description: ABSENCE SEMANTIC: null = the FIRST basis (no predecessor) -- never an unrecorded lineage

change.description: The Basis_Change that produced this basis from its predecessor. ABSENCE SEMANTIC: null iff predecessor_basis_id is null (the first mint has no change). Change ops are classified by COMPUTED AUTHORITY EFFECT (PRD sec.2.3: Allowed(K_after) minus Allowed(K_before)), NEVER by opcode -- an ADD can contract and a RETIRE can expand; the opcode records WHAT was edited, the effect records WHAT IT DID. MULTI-MEMBER RATIFICATION (0.1.1, stated so no seat improvises): a change touching N members is N SEQUENTIAL MINTS, each basis carrying ONE change on ONE member -- lineage preserved, one effect computed per edit; there is no multi-member change object by design.

op.description: PRD sec.2.3's change protocol, reused not re-coined. A version re-pin with ZERO content change is NOT a change op -- it is the same basis (identity), stated so no-op bumps cannot manufacture invalidation events.

authority_effect.description: COMPUTED classification of Allowed(K_after) vs Allowed(K_before): EXPANDING (something newly allowed), CONTRACTING (something newly disallowed), MIXED (both), NEUTRAL (neither). ABSENCE SEMANTIC: null = UNCOMPUTED (the effect computation did not complete) -- an instrument state, NOT a fifth kind of effect (the NOT_EXERCISABLE lesson); every consumer gate treats an UNCOMPUTED effect as EXPANDING (fail toward the higher bar: authority-expanding edits take the sec.2.8 retirement machinery's scrutiny).

effect_computation_ref.description: pointer to the computation's record (the derivation, its instrument, its vintage). ABSENCE SEMANTIC: null forces authority_effect null (a computed claim without its computation is an authored claim)
